scoring_justification: Full recomputation of Ea/AIMD from raw trajectories is beyond the verifier sandbox; therefore we compare agent's reported values against paper gold with tolerances and structural inequality/ordering rules.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold activation energies and pre-exponential factors from the paper (Table I).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's summary table; all values traceable to specific sections.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported results; used only as reference with generous 50% tolerance to absorb legitimate implementation variance while anchoring the required trend.

outputs.description: Activation energies and diffusion pre-exponential factors for lithium-ion migration in at least three superionic conductors (Li3N, LiGaO2, LiIO3, Li3OCl), comparing zero-temperature NEB barriers with finite-temperature AIMD results.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker verifies that for each material Ea_AIMD > Ea_0_NEB by at least 0.05 eV, that the Ea_AIMD ordering across materials is monotonic with respect to paper-reported values (Li3N < LiIO3 < Li3OCl < LiGaO2) allowing small inversions (<0.1 eV), and that absolute values are within 50% tolerance of the paper's reported values. LiF is optional and not scored. At least three materials must satisfy both inequality and ordering for full credit.
